title: retry_join_requests resets the join-request fetch by hand from the UI, in the session
trigger: press Retry on the failed requests box
effect: none today; the stage is removed from outside its own transitions before ask_join_requests
fix: driver method retry_join_requests that replaces the stage with Loading in one place

title: non-test Rc<RefCell<Option<body>>> borrow_mut().take() in a dialog content closure
trigger: the dialog content closure runs a second time for the same build
effect: second run takes None and draws an empty body
fix: build the body inside the closure (or a shared scrollable_dialog_content_once helper) instead of a take-once slot

title: DropOnRow keeps hover beside the drag it belongs to
trigger: hover is set by file and forward drags; forward_takes_over clears it only when the file drag had state, forward_over_row/drag_over_row reset seen without touching it
effect: none today; a row can stay lit with no drag in seen
fix: hover inside Dragged::Files/Forward (a row per drag variant); preview as a demo-only variant

title: Freeze::Frozen with an empty order is a hidden third stage (released, timer still running)
trigger: a drag rests two seconds with the pointer still down: release_order clears the map but the Frozen value and its finished timer stay
effect: none; is_held() and order() read emptiness as 'thawed' while the value says Frozen
fix: Freeze { Thawed, Held{order,timer}, Released{timer} } or drop the timer when released

title: FileDrag fields kind, paths, position are set in step by hand and has_state() ORs three of them
trigger: drag_over_row writes kind and paths together on a fresh drag and position separately
effect: none today
fix: FileDrag as Probed{paths,kind} / Unsendable{paths} with position and rest inside the stage

title: A failed topic load in the drop chooser has no retry
trigger: drop a file on a forum row whose topics cannot be loaded
effect: 'topics could not load' with only Cancel; the load is sent once in open_drop_topic
fix: a Retry button that resends load_forum_topics, or a DropTopic stage Loading/Failed/Ready

title: non-test Rc<RefCell<Option<body>>> borrow_mut().take() in a dialog content closure
trigger: the dialog content closure runs a second time for the same build
effect: second run takes None and draws an empty body
fix: build the body inside the closure (or a shared scrollable_dialog_content_once helper) instead of a take-once slot

title: The chat list view is two fields in two structs that must change together
trigger: every view change goes through set_chat_list_view; enter_community_chat_list_mode/exit_community_chat_list_mode and open_folder_tab pass the other half from the field
effect: none today; a direct write to either field skips ending the selection and pin drag
fix: one ChatListView { filter, folder } value owned by ChatListUi

title: Saved Messages click is dropped while any createPrivateChat is in flight (deduped by purpose, not by user)
trigger: click a bot's user button (createPrivateChat for another user), then Open Saved Messages before it answers
effect: create_private_chat_with_self returns Ok(None), the arm does nothing and no note; the open of the earlier answer decides which chat opens
fix: key the in-flight create by user id (a stage holding RequestId and user) and open the chat of the answer's own request

title: non-test RefCell borrow_mut of row_fx in render
trigger: chat list renders while a row painter holds row_fx
effect: re-entrant borrow panics
fix: try_borrow_mut with early return

title: PinStage is ended by hand from render and from five other places instead of its own transitions
trigger: press a pinned row and start a drag, then switch to Contacts, Calls or open search: open_contacts_tab/open_calls_tab do not end it, sidebar_ready ends it during render; sidebar_chats ends it when the window is inactive; pin_drag_move, cancel_pin_drag and set_chat_list_view also call end_drag; pin_drag_move also writes peek=Idle by hand
effect: none visible; a render-time write that a missed path would leave as a 60 Hz redraw
fix: one ChatListUi::leave_view() / on_tab_change transition that ends pin drag, peek and items

title: ChatLookDialog::both is a one-shot argument of Apply stored as a flag
trigger: Click Apply for me and user; retry after a failure with the other button
effect: The flag is set before the in-flight check and read later by apply_chat_look; a retry of a Failed change uses the new button's value
fix: pass `only_for_self` as an argument of apply_chat_look and store it in the Sent stage

title: Blocked replaces Sent, so the Done changes are forgotten
trigger: Boosted chat: Apply with two changes, one Done and one Failed, then change the pick so Apply is blocked by the level, then fix it and Apply again
effect: Already acknowledged changes are sent again (mod.rs sets d.stage = LookStage::Blocked over Sent)
fix: Blocked carries the previous sends, or Sent has a blocked reason field

title: chat_list.row_fx.borrow_mut() in the per-row render
trigger: Row render while sidebar begin_pass or another borrow is live
effect: Short temporary borrow today; would panic on a re-entrant borrow
fix: try_borrow_mut with a settled default RowFx

title: baseline: RowForum::loaded is Fetch loaded-or-failed squashed into a bool
trigger: Forum row whose getForumTopics failed
effect: Failed reads as loaded: 'No chats' with no retry, as documented (asked once)
fix: RowForum::topics: Fetch-like enum { Loading, Empty, Failed, Some }

title: Non-test RefCell borrow/borrow_mut on the shared WindowSlot
trigger: note_place/main_covered/covered_chat_windows/image_caches/activate borrow the slot while another path (swap_slot, render) may hold borrow_mut
effect: Panic and process exit if a borrow overlaps (cover.rs 95,115,126,153; mod.rs 273,288,296,358,379,541); open_places and slice_ids already use try_borrow
fix: use try_borrow/try_borrow_mut with an early return as open_places does

title: Host::Asked is matched by kind and expired by 'no request in flight at all', not by a RequestId
trigger: A box asked from a chat window whose request never opens it while any other request is in flight
effect: The ask stays Asked(window), so a later open of that kind by a reducer shows in the stale window instead of the last press (shell.rs expiry uses requests.is_empty())
fix: Host::Asked(window, Option<RequestId>) expired by that request's answer

title: Restore drops a saved window whose open was refused, and the next save forgets it
trigger: Launch with a saved chat window whose chat is unsupported or whose driver open_chat_window fails
effect: open_chat_window_at returns nothing; ready windows are consumed from Restore::Opening whatever the result, a note is posted, and windows_to_save(Done) then rewrites the file without that window, so it never comes back
fix: use try_open_chat_window_at and keep refused windows in Opening for a retry, or drop them with a deliberate Dropped step

title: Offered stage re-asks whenever no dialog is active, so a dismissal that does not call on_cancel re-opens the box every frame
trigger: Dismiss the Restore chat windows box with Escape or click-away (if the kit reports on_close, not on_cancel)
effect: The question comes back on the next frame and cannot be answered away; the stage has no explicit dismissed exit
fix: Offered holds the box identity and treats a dismissal as answer(false) or Later

title: Non-test RefCell borrow_mut/borrow on the shared WindowSlot in swap_slot, chat_frame_starts and view.rs:304
trigger: Any path that holds a Ref on a slot while a scope swap runs
effect: borrow_mut in swap_slot (slot.rs:311) panics if the slot is already borrowed; borrow() at slot.rs:438 and view.rs:304 can panic if a mutable borrow is live. No such path found today
fix: try_borrow_mut with a skipped swap, or Cell-based fields

title: bounds_seen is not updated by render_locked, so a window moved or resized under the lock reopens at stale bounds
trigger: Lock Quill, move a chat window, close it from its title bar, use Reopen closed window
effect: closing() reads self.bounds_seen (line 106) which stops updating while locked; the window comes back at its pre-lock place
fix: read bounds from the slot recorded by placed()/note_place, or update bounds_seen in the locked path

title: CreateVisibility busy is matched by request purpose (has_purpose(CreateCommunity)), not by the chat or request that asked
trigger: Press Create on a community, close the box, start another create from a different chat while the first is out
effect: The second box's Create button is loading and disabled until the first answers; the submit path uses has_purpose_for_chat so the two checks disagree
fix: use community_create_out(chat_id) (or the RequestId held in the stage) for busy

title: community_candidates status ignores owned_bots loading, so the chooser says No chats found while owned bots load
trigger: Open Add a Chat to Community on an account with no suitable chats but owned bots
effect: status stays Ready (only owned_bots.error() is read), the empty list shows No chats found, then the bots appear on the next frame
fix: fold both fetches into one status: Loading while either loads

title: The photo picker answer is applied to whichever Create box is open, not the draft that asked
trigger: Open the photo picker in Create for chat A, cancel the box, open Create from chat B, then choose a file in the still-open picker
effect: draft.photo of box B is set from A's picker; the guard compares account only
fix: carry the draft (name entity id) in the task and apply only if it is still the open one

title: A newer community ban silently replaces a ban still waiting for its member chats
trigger: Press Ban on member A, then Ban on member B before A's getCommunityMemberChats answers
effect: ban_wait is overwritten, A's confirmed ban never happens and no note is shown
fix: a queue of PendingBan, or refuse the second press with a note while one waits

title: A second window sending in the same bot chat gets a false 'couldn't start a thread' note: start_bot_thread dedups by purpose+chat, not by the asking window's request
trigger: Open the same bot chat in two windows, Send in the All view in one, then in the other before the thread is created
effect: start_bot_thread returns Ok(None) for the second window; .ok().flatten() turns that into the error note while the first window's thread is being made; the second send must be repeated
fix: Per-window Asked stage keyed by RequestId; a second window waits on the in-flight request id instead of an error

title: close_mention_menu and pick_mention_index clear the session-wide messages.mention_search, shared by every window
trigger: Type @ in the composer of two chat windows alternately
effect: Closing or completing the menu in one window drops the other window's search results; its menu empties until the next keystroke
fix: Keep the mention search per window (WindowSlot/ComposerUi) keyed by its request

title: RefCell borrow_mut on the bar Presence in render (follow_bar)
trigger: Render a reply or edit bar while a nested render re-enters follow_bar for the same presence
effect: A re-entrant borrow_mut would panic and end the app; today the guard is dropped before request_animation_tick
fix: Use try_borrow_mut with an early return, as history_reads does, or a Cell-based presence
